intro.zh: 暖中性色纸面、衬线标题、细线与大量留白，安静克制；适合学术研究、论文答辩和需要从容叙述的汇报。
intro.en: Warm neutral paper, serif titles, fine rules and open space; quiet and unhurried, for academic research, thesis defences and measured narratives.
intro.ja: 温かい中間色の紙面、セリフ体見出し、細い罫線と余白。学術研究や論文発表など落ち着いた説明向け。

routing.avoid: Loud product launches or dense dashboards that need saturated colour.

pageMapping.differences: Same left-aligned kicker, serif title and subtitle on paper; the two thin concentric circles and the edge dot pager are not drawn, and the kicker sits at the top of the page instead of directly above the title.
Source is a two-column page: title and intro on the left, four numbered rows separated by hairlines on the right; native is a top title with one row of four outlined rounded boxes joined by arrows.
Source centres the sentence under a quote glyph with a small-caps label below and a large faint circle; native is left-aligned with the label above and no glyph or circle.

Source puts title and description in a left column beside the chart and pairs solid black bars with outlined target bars; native puts the title on top with a full-width editable chart of one filled series.

Source has the image on the left, title and two paragraphs on the right, and a ruled row of three figures; native has the title on top, bullets on the left, the image region on the right and no figure row.
Source centres the title over three bordered, filled cards each with a small circled roman numeral; native has a left title and three open blocks with a leading vertical rule and no numerals.
Native two-series line chart with editable data under a top title; the area fill under the main line, the dotted comparison series and the right-aligned description are not reproduced.
Source is four left-aligned text columns under one hairline, each with a small-caps phase label; native draws a line with a dot per phase and centred labels.
Source shows four circular initial avatars with centred name and role under a centred title; native shows four open text blocks with a leading rule and no avatars.
Source is centred inside two large concentric circles; native reuses the left-aligned cover layout without circles.
